summary.plain: An experiment deep inside a Russian mountain that uses tonnes of liquid gallium metal to catch the Sun's lowest-energy neutrinos.
summary.technical: Radiochemical liquid-gallium solar-neutrino experiment at the Baksan Neutrino Observatory, Russia, ~2100 m underground; 50-57 t gallium target. Measured a solar neutrino capture rate of 67.2 (+7.2/-7.0 stat) (+3.5/-3.0 syst) SNU over 1990-1997, about half the Standard Solar Model prediction of 129 SNU.
